name: wayword
description: A local-first writing practice for noticing language patterns across short runs.

scripts.build: npm run build:runtime-env && npm run build:mirror
scripts.test:smoke:cross-browser: npm run test:smoke:chromium && npm run test:smoke:firefox && npm run test:smoke:webkit
scripts.test:browser:run-parity: WAYWORD_BROWSER=chromium node --test tests/browser-smoke.test.cjs --test-name-pattern "back-to-back submits preserve observatory parity and storage parity"
scripts.test:logic: node --test tests/app-logic.test.cjs tests/mirror-pipeline.test.cjs tests/patterns-aggregation.test.cjs tests/persistence-migration.test.cjs tests/retention-telemetry.test.cjs tests/auth-session-runtime.test.cjs tests/founder-alpha-pulse.test.cjs tests/static-server.test.cjs tests/alpha-pulse-dashboard.test.cjs tests/alpha-pulse-summary.test.cjs tests/alpha-pulse-api-route.test.cjs
scripts.verify:merge: npm test && node --check script.js && npm run verify:mirror-bundle && npm run verify:brand-lock && npm run verify:patterns-surface
scripts.verify:alpha: npm run verify:merge && npm run test:smoke
scripts.test:regression: npm test && node --check script.js && npm run test:smoke
